issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go] Issue #1: Create Plunk email template & obtain template ID
issues.main_description_html:
Feature: Photographer Update Notification Email (support@gothru.co) Effort: S | Blocking | Non-code | Labels: email, blocked, infra

Create the 'Photographer Updated' transactional template in the Plunk dashboard based on the GoThru email design doc. Capture the template ID and exact merge-field names.

Acceptance criteria:

  • Template exists in Plunk and renders a test send.
  • Template ID and full field list documented in repo (README or .env.example).
  • Field list reconciled with planning.md section 5.

Depends on: email design from Google Doc. Ref: brainstorm/brainstorming-api.md TASK-1

Testing Scenario

  • Render check: Send a Plunk test using the new template with full sample merge data; every field renders, no literal {{placeholders}} remain.
  • Template ID valid: A direct Plunk API call using the captured template ID returns 2xx.
  • Field-name match: Template merge fields exactly match the payload keys in planning.md §5 (no typos/casing diff).
  • Graceful degradation (negative): Send with one field omitted; template shows blank, not a raw placeholder.
  • Both data sources visible: Sample includes directory (photographer) AND dashboard (account) values, both appear in the rendered email.

Email Template & Routing (final)

Routing — From info@gothru.co → To support@gothru.co (internal notice). Sender (From): set the Plunk template/project sender to info@gothru.co (option a — no code change; PlunkPayload has no from field). Full source: brainstorm/email-template-photographer-update.md.

Subject

[Photographer Update] {{photographer_full_name}} — {{submission_status}}

Plain text

Hello GoThru Support Team,

A photographer has updated their data in the GoThru Photographer directory.
The details below are provided for your review.

The submission is currently marked as {{submission_status}}, and may require a
re-review before approval.

GoThru Account
  Name : {{gothru_full_name}}
  Email: {{gothru_email}}

Submission Details
  Name        : {{photographer_full_name}}
  Email       : {{photographer_email}}
  Request Date: {{request_date}}
  Status      : {{submission_status}}

Changes Summary:
  "{{changes_summary}}"

Please review this submission in the GoThru admin dashboard (Photographer
Directory) and take any necessary action.

— This is an automated notification from GoThru Maps.

Merge fields the backend must supply (see #3): gothru_full_name, gothru_email, photographer_full_name, photographer_email, request_date, submission_status, changes_summary.

Still to confirm: {{submission_status}} label strings (1=pending…4=featured), request_date = created_at?, how changes_summary is derived (see #3).

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go] Issue #3: Core action: assemble payload + send (MVP, synchronous)
issues.main_description_html:
Feature: Photographer Update Notification Email Effort: M | Labels: backend, email Files: src/action/v1/photographers/notifyPhotographerUpdate.go (new)

Implement NotifyPhotographerUpdate(gothruUserId, req): load photographer (ConnPhotographers) and dashboard user (ConnGothruMod), build map[string]string payload (directory + dashboard fields + optional changed-field diff per planning.md section 5), send via helpers.SendEmail to Env.SupportEmail.

Acceptance criteria:

  • 404 when photographer not found; partial payload (no error) when dashboard user missing.
  • Status->label and subscription->Pro/Agency label resolved.
  • Structured data flattened to strings; diff rendered into a single field.
  • Clear error if Plunk/template not configured.

Depends on: TASK-2. Ref: brainstorm/brainstorming-api.md TASK-3

Testing Scenario

  • Happy path: Valid gothruUserId → payload contains directory + dashboard fields; SendEmail called once to Env.SupportEmail with the correct template ID.
  • Photographer not found: Unknown id → returns gorm.ErrRecordNotFound.
  • Dashboard user missing: Photographer exists but no GothruUser → partial payload, no error; dashboard fields blank/omitted.
  • Status label mapping: status 1→pending … 4→featured resolve correctly.
  • Subscription tier: subscription in PRO_SUBSCRIPTIONS → Pro/Agency label; else Free/Basic.
  • Diff rendering: changedFields provided → diff flattened into a single string field (old → new).
  • Config error: Plunk/template not configured → action returns a clear error.
  • DB warming up: ConnGothruMod not ready → tolerated, partial payload (no nil panic).

Routing note (update)

  • Send To = Env.SupportEmail (support@gothru.co).
  • From info@gothru.co is handled by Plunk template config (option a) — the action passes only to, template, data (no from).
  • Payload keys to build (match the Plunk template merge fields): gothru_full_name, gothru_email, photographer_full_name, photographer_email, request_date, submission_status, changes_summary (pre-rendered changed-fields diff, string).

Feature: Photographer Update Notification Email Effort: S | Labels: backend, api Files: src/controllers/v1/photographers/notifyPhotographerUpdate.go (new), src/routes/v1/photographersRoutes.go (edit)

issues.display_title: [GoThruMedia/gothru-maps-backend-go] Issue #11: [#3.1] Add ComputeRanking pure function (single source of truth)

New ComputeRanking(...) int = tier_baseline(subscription) + min(completed_field_count, MaxFieldBonus).

Acceptance: covered by unit tests (#3.6) before wiring in.

Summary

On the photographer profile page (/photographer/[slug]), the large 360° tour viewer at the top of the page always renders. When a photographer has no virtual tour, it falls back to a tall "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder block. This empty block dominates the top of the page and looks unpolished.

We need to hide the tour viewer entirely when there is no tour, and just show the photographer detail (profile card, contact, about, information, reviews, portfolio).

"if there is not tour ... we need to hide this ... it does not look nice"

Current behavior

  • The profile page renders a hero <iframe> section at the top inside PhotographerProfile.
  • The tour URL is resolved by the usePortfolioIframe hook, which exposes validIframeUrl and isCheckingUrl.
  • Render states today:
    • isCheckingUrl === true → loading Skeleton.
    • validIframeUrl truthy → the 360° tour <iframe>.
    • otherwise → the "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder block (the part we want to remove).

Expected behavior

  • When there is a valid tour → keep showing the tour viewer exactly as it does now.
  • When there is no tour (no valid iframe URL after the check completes) → do not render the tour viewer section at all (no empty placeholder). The page should start with the photographer detail content instead, with no awkward empty gap or leftover spacing/border where the viewer used to be.
  • The loading skeleton should still show only while the URL is being checked, then collapse cleanly if no tour is found (no flash of the placeholder).
  • The "Contact photographer" call-to-action that lived inside the placeholder is already available elsewhere on the page (the contact button in the profile card), so no contact entry point is lost.

Acceptance criteria

  • Profile page with a valid tour still shows the 360° viewer (no regression).
  • Profile page with no tour shows no tour viewer and no "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder.
  • No empty container, border, or vertical gap remains at the top when the viewer is hidden.
  • No layout shift / flash of the placeholder while the tour URL is being validated.
  • Contact, about, information, reviews, and portfolio sections render normally in both cases.
  • Responsive: verified on mobile and desktop widths.

Technical notes (for the developer)

  • Component: src/components/photographer-profile.tsx — the hero <section> containing the iframe / placeholder.
  • Hook: src/components/pages/photographer/hooks/usePortfolioIframe.ts (validIframeUrl, isCheckingUrl).
  • Server data: src/app/photographer/[slug]/page.tsx resolves initialIframeUrl from getPhotographerPortfolioGothru (firstPortfolio.tourUrl / firstPortfolio.value).
  • Implementation hint: when !isCheckingUrl && !validIframeUrl, return null for the hero section (drop the placeholder branch) rather than rendering the empty state.

Testing scenarios (QA / tester)

Reach a profile page via the directory/search, or directly at /photographer/<slug>.

Scenario 1 — Photographer WITH a tour (regression check)

  1. Open a photographer profile that has a published 360° tour.
  2. Expect: the 360° tour viewer renders at the top and is interactive/fullscreen-able, exactly as before.
  3. Expect: all detail sections below (profile, contact, about, information, reviews, portfolio) render normally.

Scenario 2 — Photographer WITHOUT a tour (the fix)

  1. Open a photographer profile that has no tour.
  2. Expect: there is no large tour viewer and no "No virtual tour available yet" placeholder at the top.
  3. Expect: the page begins with the photographer detail content, with no empty box, border, or large blank gap at the top.
  4. Expect: the "Contact photographer" button is still reachable from the profile card.

Scenario 3 — Loading / no flash

  1. Open a profile with no tour on a slow/throttled connection (DevTools → Network → Slow 3G).
  2. Expect: while the tour URL is being checked, only the loading skeleton may appear.
  3. Expect: once the check completes with no tour, the viewer area collapses cleanly — the placeholder must not flash before disappearing.

Scenario 4 — Layout & responsiveness

  1. Repeat Scenarios 1 and 2 at mobile (~375px), tablet (~768px), and desktop (≥1280px) widths.
  2. Expect: no broken spacing, no double borders, and no horizontal scroll in either the "with tour" or "no tour" state.

Scenario 5 — Cross-section integrity

  1. On a no-tour profile, exercise Contact, Add review, Sub Locations, and Equipment dialogs, and the portfolio section.
  2. Expect: every feature works the same as on a profile that has a tour — hiding the viewer must not affect any other behavior.

Reference: see docs/PROJECT_ANALYSIS.md (§3.5 Portfolios, §2 Application Routes) for how the profile page and portfolio providers fit together.
